children.label: Description
children.help_text: Optional. One or two sentences under the heading.
children.default: The OMS sits between the systems you already run. Your eCommerce platform and POS keep selling, your ERP stays the system of record for stock and finance, your warehouse keeps its own system, and the OMS keeps inventory in sync across your storefronts, ERP, and warehouses and decides where each order ships from.
